recent_mistakes.question_redacted: Restoration of expired appeal deadline after Supreme Administrative Court refused leave to appeal — which court, which statute, what evidence?
recent_mistakes.what_advocat_said: Correctly routed to KHO and identified the legal route, but cited outdated 'Hallintolainkäyttölaki 434/2003' instead of the in-force statute.
recent_mistakes.what_it_should_be: Laki oikeudenkäynnistä hallintoasioissa (HOL) 808/2019, §§ 53 + 114 + 115 — restoration of a lapsed time-limit on 'painava syy' grounds, filed at KHO only.
recent_mistakes.fix_description: advice_corrections memory entry exists but did not fire on this query; debugging cross-language retrieval threshold and citation grounder enforcement.

recent_mistakes.question_redacted: What evidence is needed to argue 'painava syy' for menetetyn määräajan palauttaminen?
recent_mistakes.what_advocat_said: Mentioned the procedural route but again cited the wrong vintage of statute and did not list KHO's typical evidentiary thresholds (notification proof, illness/incapacity records, etc.).
recent_mistakes.what_it_should_be: HOL 808/2019 § 114–115 cited explicitly; required evidence list: saantitodistus / postal-return record, illness or incapacity documentation, third-party correspondence proving non-receipt.
recent_mistakes.fix_description: Same root cause as gold-001 — corrections memory retrieval not firing on Russian-language queries about Finnish statute.

recent_mistakes.what_it_should_be: KrMS § 38 — kannatanu õigus riigi õigusabile — cited inline.

approach_notes: Truth set is held back from the public — 30 items, mix of gold/statute/adversarial.
Both v4 and bare Sonnet candidates run claude-sonnet-4-20250514. The delta is from the pipeline (consilium + corrections memory + grounding + adversarial critic), not the underlying model.
Judges score 1–5 across 5 axes (citation, conclusion, jurisdiction, completeness, calibration). Mean of judges = item score. Both reference and candidate position-swapped to guard position bias.
We publish the regressions too. The Statute-tier −3.94% is the most uncomfortable number on this page; we left it in.
Re-evaluated after every meaningful prompt or pipeline change. Run cost: $3.68 per full evaluation.
Owner is using Advocat on their own immigration case (Sulga v. Finland). Anonymised facts from that case seed part of the gold tier — a known conflict of interest. Disclosed here and in About.

cost_and_latency.note: v4 is +24% more expensive per call and +27% slower than bare Sonnet. The pipeline trades latency for adversarial safety.
